$comment: L2I-05-CTX-DIALOGS: dialog-depth contracts for ctx-menu dialog rows. Each entry overrides the shallower ctx-* drop-in definition (overrides-loader sorts by filename; dlg-ctx.json loads after all ctx-* files, before dlg-insert-img.json). depth chain: pre opens #ctx-menu (or the in-table/on-image variant) -> trigger clicks the [data-ctx] row (or #btn-table-ops) -> assertion dialog-action clicks the dialog's action button and asserts the dialog closed. Buttons' close behaviour grep-verified in frontend-dist/word/editor.js.

ctx.link.note: ledger row: ctx.link — ctx data-ctx=Link (closeCtx + insertLink) opens #link-dialog; #btn-link-ok -> confirmLinkDialog removes .open unconditionally before the URL guard (editor.js:2943-2947), so the dialog-action depth click observes a clean close

ctx.content-control-settings.note: ledger row: ctx.content-control-settings — ctx-menu-on-cc pre plants a span.content-control and selects inside it, so contentControlAtSelection() finds the control: the handler sets ccEditTarget, primes #cc-type/#cc-title from the control and openDlg("cc-dialog") (editor.js:10058-10074); #btn-cc-ok refreshes the control (type + label) then closeDlg removes .open (editor.js:13240-13250), dialog-action observes the clean close

ctx.convert-to-shape.note: ledger row: ctx.convert-to-shape — ctx data-ctx=ConvertToShape (editor.js:9872) -> openShapePicker(selectedObject()) opens #shape-dialog with #btn-shape-ok DISABLED (editor.js:3852); post clicks the first .shape-option so selectShape arms the button, then dialog-action #btn-shape-ok -> confirmShapePicker -> closeShapePicker removes .open (editor.js:3877-3879)

ctx.replace-image.note: ledger row: ctx data-ctx=ReplaceImage (editor.js:9752) -> applyObjectOp("replace-image") -> insertImage() opens #image-dialog with #btn-image-ok disabled; assertion.files closes the former vocab gap — the runner's setInputFiles drive produces a real FileList so onImageFileChange reads the GIF via FileReader and arms the button (editor.js:3122-3164), then dialog-action clicks it: confirmImageDialog inserts the decoded img at the saved caret and closeImageDialog removes .open (editor.js:3172-3179, 3237-3242)

ctx.table-advanced-settings.note: ledger row: ctx.table-advanced-settings — no ctx-menu row exists; the reachable surface is #btn-table-ops -> openTableOps -> #table-ops-dialog (editor.js:2869-2871); #op-row-above runs insertTableRow(true) then closeTableOpsDialog removes .open (editor.js:5016+5026), so the depth click both inserts a fixture row (ctx-menu-in-table pre keeps currentTableCell() live) and closes the dialog

ctx.paragraph-advanced-settings.note: ledger row: ctx.paragraph-advanced-settings — ctx data-ctx=ParagraphSettings opens openParagraphSettingsDialog -> #paragraph-settings-dialog (editor.js:5139); the prescribed #ps-keep-next is a checkbox whose only sink is applyParagraphSettings via #btn-ps-ok (editor.js:2614-2616), so the toggle itself never closes the dialog — depth observable is the flipped checkbox state (#ps-keep-next:checked matches only after the post click)

ctx.set-numbering-value.note: ledger row: ctx.set-numbering-value — ctx data-ctx=SetNumberingValue opens openNumberingValueDialog -> #numbering-value-dialog (editor.js:5045); #btn-numbering-ok -> confirmNumberingValueDialog removes .open (editor.js:5060-5064), dialog-action observes the clean close

ctx.adjust-list-indents.note: ledger row: ctx.adjust-list-indents — ctx data-ctx=AdjustListIndents opens openListIndentsDialog -> #list-indents-dialog (editor.js:5083); #btn-list-indents-ok -> confirmListIndentsDialog removes .open (editor.js:5095-5099), dialog-action observes the clean close

ctx.several-rows-columns.note: ledger row: ctx.several-rows-columns — the prescribed #op-insert-count is a number input (input-set, not in runner vocab); the wired button #op-apply-rows does the depth action: insertTableRow(false, severalCount()) reading #op-insert-count, then closeTableOpsDialog removes .open (editor.js:5036-5038) — dialog-action with the ctx-menu-in-table pre keeps currentTableCell() live for a real fixture insert

ctx.add-comment.note: ledger row: ctx.add-comment — ctx data-ctx=AddComment -> openCommentDialog opens #comment-dialog (editor.js:9894/4345); #btn-comment-ok -> confirmCommentDialog removes .open unconditionally before the commentRange guard (editor.js:4362-4366), dialog-action observes the clean close
